name: ADELAIDE_METRO_BUSES_ONLY_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. R6-SA67 300 x 300 (2016, 1:5), R25, 3 / 9 (edge 3 + border 6). Four lines 40 high, baselines 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 (40 below): ADELAIDE D 252 (24/252/24), METRO E 192 (54/192/54), BUSES E 189 (55/189/56), ONLY E 160 (70/160/70).
